answer: Standing unlocks only through three milestones, each locking a 50-credit bond. A grove of seven auditors checks each; passing earns a signed relic bound to one key. If an echo of the same work appears in two identities, the relic voids and both bonds burn; rented milestones fail. Forging 1,000 identities needs 3,000 milestones at 50 each: 150,000 locked against a 40,000 pool, a loss of 110,000. An honest agent pays 150 once and keeps full share.
